recording_config.reference: docker run eceasy/cli-proxy-api:v7.3.4 with _cpa_edge_ref/run/config.yaml (port 18317, api-keys [oracle-local-key-1], remote-management secret-key oracle-mgmt-key-1)
recording_config.extra_port_mapping: -p 127.0.0.1:51121:51121  (REQUIRED for forwarder cases; the loopback forwarder binds 0.0.0.0:51121 inside the container)

placeholders.<state>: 32-hex state value returned by a prior antigravity-auth-url call in the SAME case; substitute the actual value and list it in meta.yaml dynamic_fields
placeholders.<catalog model>: pick a model id from GET /v0/management/model-definitions/antigravity at recording time (catalog is remote-refreshed; record the chosen id in meta.yaml)

notes: Every response carries the standard CORS block; record it but it is not case-specific.
Go marshals gin.H maps with ALPHABETICAL keys; fixture bytes will show e.g. {"state":..,"status":"ok","url":..} - do not 'fix' the order.
Sessions live 30 min; the forwarder lives while its session is pending (>=5 min). Record the forwarder probes immediately after the auth-url call.

After each case that starts a session, DELETE /v0/management/oauth-session?state=<state> (expect cancelled true/false) or restart the container between case-groups to keep state clean. Prefer container restart per case-group.
For curl: use -v, do NOT auto-follow redirects (-no Location-follow), keep request bytes exact.

cases.purpose: Pin the 200 shape of GET /v0/management/antigravity-auth-url and the exact Google authorization URL: fixed client_id, redirect_uri http://localhost:51121/oauth-callback, prompt=consent, access_type=offline, response_type=code, five scopes in fixed order, params alphabetically encoded.
cases.record: status + response headers + body. Assertable: JSON keys exactly {state,status,url}; status='ok'; state matches ^[0-9a-f]{32}$; url starts with https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth? and contains access_type=offline, client_id=1071006060591-tmhssin2h21lcre235vtolojh4g403ep.apps.googleusercontent.com, prompt=consent, redirect_uri=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A51121%2Foauth-callback, response_type=code, scope=<five space-separated scopes>, state=<state>.
dynamic_fields: state (in JSON body and inside url query param)

cases.purpose: 401 error family on antigravity-auth-url: missing management key and invalid management key.
cases.record: Both: status 401, body {"error":"missing management key"} / {"error":"invalid management key"}.

cases.purpose: The 302 redirect contract of the loopback forwarder started by is_webui=1: Location = http://127.0.0.1:18317/antigravity/callback with the raw incoming query, Cache-Control: no-store, plus the follow-up hop to the main-port callback returning the success HTML.

requests.note: loopback forwarder; expect 302 Found; DO NOT let curl auto-follow; record status, Cache-Control, Location
the Location target followed manually; expect 200 + success HTML

cases.record: Step 2: full 302 exchange (status line, Cache-Control: no-store, Location: http://127.0.0.1:18317/antigravity/callback?code=ac_test_code&state=<state>, Go redirect HTML body). Step 3: 200 + exact oauthCallbackSuccessHTML bytes.

cases.purpose: Forwarder path-rewrite rule: ANY path is redirected to /antigravity/callback; incoming path discarded; raw query preserved (multi-param, ordering preserved).
cases.record: Step 2 full 302 exchange incl. Location byte-exact.

cases.purpose: A second is_webui flow replaces the existing forwarder: the same loopback port now redirects with the NEW session state (no error, single listener).
cases.record: Step 3: 302 exchange; Location contains <state2>.

cases.purpose: Main-port GET /antigravity/callback with an UNKNOWN (well-formed) state: 200 + success HTML, no auth required, write silently ignored.
cases.record: 200, Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8, exact oauthCallbackSuccessHTML body, CORS block present.

cases.purpose: Main-port callback variants: no query, error param present, OPTIONS (204+CORS), wrong method POST (404 empty per R-404).
cases.record: 1-2: 200 success HTML (identical bytes both times). 3: 204 No Content + CORS. 4: 404 with EMPTY body.

cases.purpose: GET/POST /v0/management/oauth-callback validation family (no management key needed): invalid body, state required, invalid state, code-or-error required, unknown state 404, unsupported provider, provider mismatch against a live antigravity session, and alias normalization.

requests.note: 404 unknown or expired state (session lookup precedes provider normalization)
provider alias normalization: expect 200 {"status":"ok"} (writes callback file with fake code; session fails exchange later - restart container after this case)

cases.record: All statuses + bodies; step 10 proves alias normalization (ANTI-GRAVITY -> antigravity).

cases.purpose: Full session lifecycle without Google: pending wait -> cancel -> unknown -> re-cancel -> main-port callback after cancel.
cases.record: All 7 exchanges in order.

cases.purpose: Browser-deny path end-to-end without Google: main-port callback with error param against a pending session sets session status 'Authentication failed' (no upstream call happens).

requests.note: poll every 500ms until status != 'wait' (waiter polls at 500ms); final value must be 200 {"error":"Authentication failed","status":"error"}

cases.record: Step 3 final response only (note settle time in meta.yaml).
dynamic_fields: settle delay (up to ~1-2s; assert final value only)

cases.purpose: JSON handoff success + deterministic exchange failure: POST oauth-callback with a fake code returns 200 ok; the waiter then fails the exchange (bogus code and/or unreachable Google) and marks the session 'Failed to exchange token' regardless of failure cause.

requests.note: poll until status != 'wait' (max 60s); final: 200 {"error":"Failed to exchange token","status":"error"}. Works with or without internet since any exchange error maps to the same message.

cases.record: Steps 1-3; record final value of step 3 only.

cases.purpose: get-auth-status degenerate inputs: no state param, empty state, invalid state characters.
cases.record: All three exchanges.

cases.purpose: DELETE oauth-session validation: missing state, invalid state.
cases.record: Both exchanges.

cases.purpose: Pin the stream contract through the mock: upstream URL .../v1internal:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse; SSE chunk translation; usageMetadata filter (non-terminal chunks renamed cpaUsageMetadata and not surfaced client-side); terminal chunk keeps usage; OpenAI client sees SSE with [DONE].

cases.record: Full downstream SSE byte stream + upstream.jsonl (incl. query string alt=sse) + mock-response.json. RECORDED OUTCOME: downstream chat.completion.chunk frames (id "", created 0, reasoning_content/tool_calls null, native_finish_reason); non-terminal usageMetadata stripped client-side; terminal chunk keeps usage {completion_tokens, prompt_tokens, total_tokens} + finish_reason stop + data: [DONE].

immediately after; with a single credential the cooldown surfaces the model_cooldown/auth_unavailable error family (S4) - record exact shape; if request-retry/cooldown config interferes, note config used
